defs.def: a person who takes photographs, especially as a job 拍照者；摄影师

ex.s: Discover why artists and photographers continue to be drawn to this special place.
ex.t: 探索为什么艺术家和摄影师一直被这个特别的地方所吸引。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: How does the author deal with the challenge as a landscape photographer in the Midwest?
ex.t: 作为中西部的一名风景摄影师，作者是如何应对这一挑战的？

ex.s: By teaming up with other photographers.
ex.t: 通过与其他摄影师合作。

ex.s: a photo beautified by a photographer
ex.t: 由摄影师美化过的照片

ex.s: Job requirements Being a wildlife photographer requires good photography skills, knowledge of animal behaviour and a lot of patience.
ex.t: 工作要求作为一名野生动物摄影师，需要具备良好的摄影技巧、动物行为知识和充足的耐心。

ex.s: Rewards of the job Wildlife photographers have the opportunity to see animals in the wild and help improve people’s understanding of them.
ex.t: 工作的回报：野生动物摄影师有机会在野外看到动物，并帮助提高人们对它们的理解。

ex.s: As a photographer I love the bright light and amazing colours: red rocks, green plants blue-green waters and blue skies.
ex.t: 作为一名摄影师，我喜爱明亮的光线和惊人的色彩：红色的岩石、绿色的植物、蓝绿色的水和蓝天。

ex.s: This ordinary-looking man was Bill Cunningham, one of the most important American photographers of the last 50 years.
ex.t: 这个相貌平平的老人就是比尔·坎宁安，过去50年来美国最重要的摄影师之一。

ex.s: Although he was a world-famous fashion photographer, Cunningham’s approach to life was uncomplicated.
ex.t: 尽管坎宁安是一位世界著名的时尚摄影师，但他的生活方式却很简单。

通过 一个 拍照者
